description: Source code for font rendering and text handling in the Battle for Wesnoth game, including font management, text rendering, word wrapping, and floating labels.

classes.name: font::manager
classes.description: Manages font initialization, font loading, and cleanup.

classes.name: font::text_surface
classes.description: Handles text rendering surfaces, measuring text size, and caching.

classes.name: font::text_cache
classes.description: Caches rendered text surfaces for performance.

classes.name: font::floating_label
classes.description: Represents floating labels with position, movement, and rendering logic.

classes.name: font::floating_label_context
classes.description: Manages context for floating labels, including drawing and undrawing.

methods.name: font::manager::manager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the TTF library.

methods.name: font::manager::~manager
methods.description: Destructor that clears fonts and quits the TTF library.

methods.name: font::set_font_list
methods.description: Sets the list of available fonts based on descriptors.

methods.name: font::load_font_config
methods.description: Loads font configuration from a config file.

methods.name: font::add_floating_label
methods.description: Creates and adds a floating label to the current context.

methods.name: font::move_floating_label
methods.description: Moves a floating label by specified offsets.

methods.name: font::scroll_floating_labels
methods.description: Scrolls all floating labels by specified amounts.

methods.name: font::remove_floating_label
methods.description: Removes a floating label by handle.

methods.name: font::show_floating_label
methods.description: Shows or hides a floating label.

methods.name: font::get_floating_label_text
methods.description: Retrieves the text of a floating label.

methods.name: font::get_floating_label_rect
methods.description: Gets the rectangle bounds of a floating label.
